classification_rationale: Peer-reviewed quantum-foundations framework (C): founding papers Page-Wootters, Phys. Rev. D 27, 2885 (1983) and Wootters, Int. J. Theor. Phys. 23, 701 (1984), with further peer-reviewed publications through January 2025 (Quantum 9, 1610 and 1616; checked 2026-08-04); any claim that it enables a device or physical effect is a speculative hypothesis (E face); each externally checkable status claim here is an external fact requiring primary-source verification (G face).
implementation_seam: Two-qubit clock/system conditional-state toy reproducing the finite two-photon conditional-state experiment of Moreva et al., Phys. Rev. A 89, 052122 (2014), including its finite-clock visibility reduction; separately, the exact ordinary-evolution equivalence theorem (Page-Wootters 1983 Sec. III; Giovannetti-Lloyd-Maccone, Phys. Rev. D 92, 045033 (2015)) applies only to a non-interacting clock, ideal in the continuous-clock limit; no device capability or physical validation is implied
legitimate_uses: A small conditional-state toy model reproducing the published two-qubit result of Moreva et al., Phys. Rev. A 89, 052122 (2014)
minimal_evidence_before_implementation: Reproduction of the published two-qubit conditional-state result (Moreva et al., Phys. Rev. A 89, 052122 (2014)) before any extension
